We need to fix compilation errors. Issues: imports for JUnit Jupiter and Mockito not available; also mixing JUnit 4 @Test import. Use JUnit 4? Simpler: replace JUnit Jupiter annotations with JUnit 4 equivalents: import org.junit.*; use @Test from org.junit.Test, @BeforeClass, @AfterClass, @Before, @After. Also @Nested not available; can just remove nested classes and make them separate test methods, but easier: keep nested as static inner classes with JUnit4? JUnit4 doesn't support @Nested. Could just remove @Nested annotation and make inner classes static with @RunWith? Simpler: flatten tests: but many tests already inside nested classes. Could convert nested classes to regular inner classes and use @RunWith(Enclosed.class) to run nested tests. Use import org.junit.runner.RunWith; import org.junit.runners.Enclosed; annotate outer class with @RunWith(Enclosed.class). Then inner static classes can have @Before, @Test etc. No need @Nested.

Also BaseBarBuilder is not public; need to use BaseBar.builder()? In ta4j library, BaseBarBuilder is public? The error says not public. Usually you use new BaseBarBuilder() is allowed within same package? It's in org.ta4j.core. Since test is in org.ta4j.core.indicators.numeric package, same top-level? BaseBarBuilder is in org.ta4j.core, not same package, so not accessible. Use BaseBar.builder() static method? In ta4j, there is BaseBarBuilder with public static builder? Actually BaseBarBuilder is a public class in org.ta4j.core. I'm not sure. Could use new BaseBarBuilder().timePeriod... but error says not public. So need to use BaseBar.builder()? Let's check typical usage: In ta4j examples, they use new BaseBarBuilder().timePeriod(...).openPrice(...).closePrice(...).build(); I think BaseBarBuilder is public. Maybe the version in repo has package-private. To avoid, we can use BaseBarSeriesBuilder which adds bars via addBar(Bar). Could create Bar via new BaseBarBuilder... but if not accessible, we can use BaseBarSeriesBuilder's with... Actually BaseBarSeriesBuilder has method withBar... Not sure.

Simpler: use series.addBar(series.numOf(v))? There is method addBar(Bar). We can create Bar using new BaseBar(Duration, ZonedDateTime, Num...). Might be complex.

Alternative: Since tests rely on series values only, we could avoid building bars using BaseBarBuilder by using series.addBar(new BaseBarBuilder(). ...). If not accessible, we can use series.addBar(series.numOf(v))? Not.

Maybe we can change imports to use org.ta4j.core.BaseBarBuilder; but it's already imported. The error about not public suggests class is package-private. So we need to use BaseBar.builder() static method? Let's assume there is a public class BaseBar with a static builder method returning BaseBarBuilder. In newer versions, BaseBarBuilder is inner class of BaseBar? Not sure.

Given limited time, we can replace usage with series.addBar(series.numOf(v))? Actually BaseBarSeriesBuilder has method addBar(Bar). Could use series.addBar(new org.ta4j.core.BaseBar(Duration.ofDays(1), ZonedDateTime.now(), DecimalNum.valueOf(v), ...). That's cumbersome.

Maybe easiest: use series.addBar(new BaseBarBuilder().timePeriod(...).closePrice(...).build()) but compile error persists.

We could change test to use series.addBar(new org.ta4j.core.BaseBarBuilder().timePeriod(...).closePrice(...).build()); but same.

Given we cannot guarantee library, maybe we can avoid building bars entirely by using MockBarSeries? But they commented out.

Alternative: Use BaseBarSeriesBuilder to add bars via with... The builder provides method withBar? I think BaseBarSeriesBuilder has method withBar(Bar). Could use .withBar(new BaseBarBuilder()...). Not sure.

Simplify: Use series.addBar(new org.ta4j.core.BaseBar(Duration.ofDays(1), ZonedDateTime.now(), DecimalNum.valueOf(v), DecimalNum.valueOf(v), DecimalNum.valueOf(v), DecimalNum.valueOf(v), DecimalNum.valueOf(v))); Provide required parameters: time period, end time, open, high, low, close, volume. Use same value for all.

We'll need import java.time.ZonedDateTime.

Implement helper method addBar(series, double v) to create Bar.

Thus replace all BaseBarBuilder usage with this helper.

Also fix imports, remove JUnit Jupiter imports, use JUnit4.

Also remove Mockito import if not available; we can keep but need dependency. Assume Mockito not present. Could replace mock test with simple stub indicator. But easier: remove Mockito usage and adjust test to use ConstantIndicator instead. But test expects mock behavior. Could implement a simple Indicator<Num> that returns constant five. Use new ConstantIndicator<>(series, DecimalNum.valueOf(5)). So modify multipliedBy_withMockedIndicator test accordingly.

Also remove usage of @BeforeAll, @AfterAll, @BeforeEach annotations; replace with @BeforeClass, @AfterClass, @Before.

Make static setup methods annotated correctly.

Also remove static import for Assertions.* and use org.junit.Assert.* methods.

Thus modify code accordingly.
